name: cp-nice-player
description: Stream audio files inside VS Code with chunked, low-latency playback powered by FFmpeg and Web Audio.

cp-nice-player.ffmpegPath.description: Optional path to the ffmpeg executable. When set, it is the only candidate. Leave empty to use ffmpeg from PATH, or a build downloaded by the extension (Linux). FFmpeg is required for playback.

enumDescriptions: Ogg Vorbis (default); use playback.oggQuality to tune quality.
cp-nice-player.playback.format.description: Output format for FFmpeg transcode before playback. Falls back to mp3 or wav when the preferred encoder is unavailable.

cp-nice-player.playback.oggQuality.description: libvorbis quality (FFmpeg -q:a) when playback.format is ogg. Higher values mean better quality and larger files.

cp-nice-player.playback.chunkDurationSec.description: Duration of each streamed audio chunk in seconds.

cp-nice-player.playback.crossfadeMs.description: Per-chunk crossfade/overlap tail length in milliseconds.

cp-nice-player.playback.prefetchSec.description: How far ahead of the playhead the player fetches chunks, in seconds of audio, counting the current chunk. The chunk count is derived from playback.chunkDurationSec.

cp-nice-player.playback.cachedIndexes.description: How many recently opened media files keep their cached stream index in memory, so reopening one skips the FFmpeg frame scan. Each index is metadata only — roughly 4.5 KB per minute of audio at the default chunk duration. Cleared when the playback server restarts.

cp-nice-player.playback.cachedChunksSec.description: Seconds of already-fetched audio the player keeps cached, so seeking back into it does not re-fetch. Spans both sides of the playhead. The chunk count is derived from playback.chunkDurationSec.

cp-nice-player.playback.debugLogging.description: Log playback settings and transcode template at startup, plus per-request server activity, to the extension host console.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
